notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.notes: [p][b]Hi![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Version [b]1.0[/b] is here![/p][p]What's new:[/p][list][*][p]Bugfixes[/p][/*][*][p]UI/UX improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Balance and progress changes[/p][/*][*][p]New version of Godot[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Thanks everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Now a few words about the past, present and future.[/p][p]It was my first game on Steam.[/p][p]I made all mistakes possible with marketing and the Steam algorithm. So sales are very low, and it is not possible to change it.[/p][p]I got experience. The hard way.[/p][p][/p][p]I used AI for image generation and music because it is not possible for me to do such a project solo.[/p][p]I don't like it. I don't like the process of making games with AI. Now I don't like AI in general. [b]Soulless.[/b][/p][p]By the way, I didn't use AI for code ːsteamthumbsupː[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry if this game didn't meet your expectations.[/p][p][/p][p]It was hard to accept mistakes. But necessary to move forward.[/p][p]Now I'm working on the next game with all this experience. Solo. No publisher. No AI. Smaller project.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll announce it everywhere. Next month, I guess.[/p][p][b]Join my YouTube channel[/b], so you don't miss the announcement trailer:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@dyvoker"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks again![/b][/p][p]To be continued...[/p]
